verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents a step-by-step walkthrough for setting up SAML-based SSO with custom apps that are not in the pre-integrated catalog, and its docs say SSO lets users sign in to company cloud apps with their managed Google account. That covers the custom SAML part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows custom OIDC or header-based app SSO. Missing for 10: custom OIDC app configuration, header-based app SSO, independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom SAML walkthrough.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs

citations.quote: প্রি-ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ক্যাটালগে নেই এমন একটি কাস্টম অ্যাপের সাথে SAML-ভিত্তিক SSO সেট আপ করতে এই ধাপগুলি অনুসরণ করুন।
L'authentification unique (SSO) permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter à toutes les applications cloud de leur entreprise à l'aide des identifiants de leur compte Google géré.
